issue_context.title: [Bug]: s3 based terraform_remote_state not support ap-south-2 region
issue_context.body:
### Terraform Core Version

1.4.6

### AWS Provider Version

5.0.1

### Affected Resource(s)

* terraform_remote_state

### Expected Behavior

Terraform should be able to read s3 based remote state in ap-south-2 region

### Actual Behavior

Terraform plan return invalid region error

### Relevant Error/Panic Output Snippet

```shell
❯ terraform plan
data.terraform_remote_state.test: Reading...

Planning failed. Terraform encountered an error while generating this plan.
╷
│ Error: Invalid AWS Region: ap-south-2

```


### Terraform Configuration Files

```terraform
provider "aws" {
  profile = "india-hyd"
  region  = "ap-south-2"
}

data "terraform_remote_state" "test" {
  backend = "s3"
  config = {
    bucket = "test"
    key    = "test.tfstate"
  }
}
```

### Steps to Reproduce

Run terraform plan with config above

It working if I add
```
skip_region_validation = true
```

_No response_

_No response_

_No response_

None

Transferring to Terraform Core repository, since this relates to the S3 backend/`terraform_remote_state`.

Ok so I have spent some time to trace the issue and it seems to be due to this dependency: 

https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform/blob/main/go.mod#L31C1-L32C1

--> this is pinned to an old version `v0.7.1` where it is reading regions from `aws/aws-sdk-go` which is further pinned to an older version where the region is not updated. https://github.com/hashicorp/aws-sdk-go-base/blob/v0.7.1/go.mod#L4

https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go/blob/v1.31.9/aws/endpoints/defaults.go#L19


The latest stable version seems to be v1.1.0 but it is still pointing to v1.31.9 which would still have the same issues (https://github.com/hashicorp/aws-sdk-go-base/blob/v1.1.0/go.mod)

v2 is still in beta -- theoretically upgrading the go.mod to v2 beta this should be fixed but I'm not too sure what the impact is at the moment

It looks only this module is ONLY used by the s3 backend component -- I am compelled to bump up the version of the module

![image](https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform/assets/36848472/1d5964b3-d62f-4004-bec9-db514d7408bd)

In the interim, the workaround is to set the [backend config parameter `skip_region_validation `](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/settings/backends/s3#skip_region_validation) to `true`.
This will be addressed in Terraform v1.6. If you still see this error when v1.6 is released (or you try any of the v1.6 beta releases), please open a new issue

review_comments: I removed this, as it seems to be irrelevant as far as configuring a s3 backend goes.

I'm not @hashicorp/terraform-aws, but it's worth noting that changing the schema for backends can cause users supplying backend configuration via variables to need to reconfigure the backend: https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform/issues/32866#issuecomment-1471921440
We therefore tend to be conservative in changing backend schemas.
